description: U.S. Marine Corps recruits with Hotel Company, 2nd Recruit Training Battalion conduct a confidence chamber event at Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton, California, July 27, 2026. The confidence chamber trains recruits on how to properly use the M50 gas mask, respond to potential chemical and biological threats, and to have trust and confidence in their issued gear. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Cpl. Eric Valerio)
